## Household and background

Simone Ardelean (born February 17, 1991) is single with no dependents. Through March she worked as a laboratory technician for Kestrel Bay Diagnostics in Anytown, NY — one W-2, box 1 wages $14,820.00, box 2 federal withholding $1,180.00. All of that work was performed in New York.

## Interview

**Q.** Was your main home in the United States for more than half of 2025?

**A.** No. I left at the beginning of April and did not keep a home here, so it was about three months in and nine months out.

**Q.** Did you earn anything after you moved, or claim the foreign earned income exclusion?

**A.** Neither. I did not work again in 2025, so there is nothing to exclude and no Form 2555.

**Q.** Any dependents or qualifying children? Could anyone claim you as a dependent?

**Q.** Were you a U.S. citizen all year?
